correctness.rationale: Standard Brownian ring target Laplace transform plus renewal formula yields F(y)=[cosh(sqrt y)/(1-p+p cosh(sqrt(by)))-1]/y. Independent symbolic series re-expansion verifies exact A1=P1/24, A2=-P2/720; polynomial elimination P2-(5b(6p-1)/2)P1=-(3b^3p-5b+2)/2 reduces to Q(b)=b^3+15b²-16b+4. Q has exactly one physical root b in (0.4,0.45), p=(5b-2)/(3b³) in (0,1); the other root p>1. The cubic coefficient H(b)/(5670b^8) is strictly positive by certified rational interval, with nonzero control Jacobian; implicit function yields y_loc=sqrt(epsilon/(3 C_*))+O(epsilon), a strict local, not global, minimum. Independent SymPy and rational checks corroborate exact proof.

value.rationale: The triple vanishing of low-order reset-rate derivatives is a natural criticality threshold for two-site Brownian search. Exact algebraic uniqueness plus a certified positive cubic and nonzero control Jacobian distinguishes genuine tricritical onset from a numerical table, and gives a quantitative local square-root law. The result neither overclaims global optimization nor attributes the earlier discovery of the coordinate to itself.
